name: Fanta Pena-Baah
role: Structural breach and explosive ordnance specialist — demolitions expert
location: The Shelf — lower district tenements near the old lakeshore, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Fanta Pena-Baah is tall and loose-limbed, moving with the deliberate economy of someone who has trained every motion. At 33, he has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate him once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains) — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He arrived in GLMZ six years ago with nothing but chrome and debts, and has been working off both ever since. He works as a demolitions expert out of The Shelf, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Fanta Pena-Baah describe him as a precision instrument — point him at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
core_desires: To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
To find the person who burned them and make it educational
To protect the people in their district who can't protect themselves
coping_mechanisms: Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
Overwork — takes every contract offered because idleness invites thinking
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Refuses to update their mental model of people — first impressions calcify into permanent judgments
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
psychology.secret: Fanta Pena-Baah maintains a second identity — a completely clean civilian persona with a lease, a job history, and a social profile. It's their exit strategy.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Flat affect, monotone delivery. The content is terrifying but the voice never rises.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
Calls everyone 'friend' — the warmth varies from genuine to threatening
example_lines: "Explosives are just engineering with a deadline. Usually a very short deadline."
"I don't blow things up. I perform structural rearrangement."
"The blast radius is your problem. My problem is making sure there's a blast."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Fanta Pena-Baah a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A crew member from Fanta Pena-Baah's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Fanta Pena-Baah's reputation — and a price for silence
narrative_function: As a demolitions expert, Fanta Pena-Baah embodies the tension between independence and isolation. He is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains). Bone lacing — titanium mesh throughout skeleton, increases durability and striking power
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.
affiliation: Independent — known in Old Harbor circles

strengths: social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: poor impulse control in specific triggers
augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Claims to live in the present but is haunted by specific moments from the past that dictate current behavior
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out

physical_description.heritage: West African / Scandinavian (Pena-Baah suggests Ghanaian-Portuguese mixed with Nordic lineage)
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with visible musculature — economical rather than bulky. Titanium bone lacing gives him a subtle rigidity in posture; no wasted mass, all functional density.
physical_description.hair_style: Short, close-cropped fade on sides, slightly longer on top — low maintenance, practical
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium golden-brown complexion, sun-darkened from outdoor work and exposure
physical_description.complexion: Sharp jawline, high cheekbones. Face carries few lines — early weathering from stress rather than age. Skin is clean but marked by occupational scars; no grooming vanity, but meticulous about scar management as part of operational security.
distinguishing_marks: Ragged scar tissue across right temple and upper scalp where cortical bomb was surgically removed — appears as a web of pale, kinked lines where hair no longer grows cleanly
Pale surgical scars on both wrists (nerve integration points for bone lacing installation, approximately 8cm each)
Burn mark on left forearm, roughly 4cm diameter, from demolition charge detonation — circa 2-3 years old, tissue remains mottled and discolored
Small, deliberate tattoo on right inner wrist: a circuit-board pattern rendered in black ink, approximately 3cm wide (personal mark, not affiliated gang work)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Scar tissue webbing across right temple where cortical bomb was removed — visible especially with short hair. Both wrists show pale surgical scarring. Subtle chrome glinting beneath skin at joints (bone lacing integration points) visible under strong light. Movement itself reveals augmentation: precision, minimal tremor, inhuman stability under load.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight balanced and centered, never fully relaxed but never tense — a coiled baseline. Moves with deliberate efficiency; no extraneous gestures. Eyes track threat vectors habitually. When handling equipment or working a site, his movements become almost meditative — slow, precise, repeatable. Natural left-hand dominant but practiced ambidextrous.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian: reinforced cargo pants (gray or black synthweave blend), durable work boots (steel-toed, modified), fitted tactical tank or henley (dark colors, moisture-wicking fabric). Oversized work jacket or reinforced denim over layers — pockets loaded with tools, dead drop tokens, secure comms units. No chrome jewelry or aesthetic chrome — everything is functional. No corporate branding. Carries himself like someone who owns nothing valuable except knowledge and capability.
